summary: DGX Spark image builds reuse a component's arm64 bundle whenever a commit with the same source tree was built, such as the merge of an already built branch
compatibility: No change to images. The arm64 receipt records the commit each reused bundle was built from.
details: The bundle cache was keyed by commit, so a merge commit with an identical tree rebuilt FlashInfer (about two hours under QEMU) and NCCL from scratch.
